# `armada cluster`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armada.md)

The cluster's status, settings, and events.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada cluster events`](#armada-cluster-events) | Show what the cluster did: crashes, rollouts, lost nodes |
| [`armada cluster set`](#armada-cluster-set) | Change cluster settings, for every server at once |
| [`armada cluster show`](#armada-cluster-show) | Show cluster settings |
| [`armada cluster status`](#armada-cluster-status) | Summarize the cluster: nodes, apps, and what needs attention |

## `armada cluster events`

Show every event from the last hour (or --since, at most 24h), oldest first: replicas
scheduled, started, crashed, moved, or removed; rollouts; nodes connected, lost,
drained, or removed; apps that cannot be placed; domains and certificates. With
--node, only that node and its replicas. An event that repeats within 10 minutes is
counted rather than shown again.

```
armada cluster events [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-f`, `--follow` | keep printing new events |
| `--node string` | only events about this node and its replicas |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (one event per line) (default `text`) |
| `--since duration` | how far back to start (at most 24h) (default `1h0m0s`) |

## `armada cluster set`

Change cluster settings. They are kept in the cluster's state, so every server
uses them, also after another one takes over as leader (ADR 0031).

With --root-domain, every app with external ingress is reachable at
https://<app>.<root-domain>. Point a wildcard DNS record (*.<root-domain>)
at your nodes first.

With --trusted-proxies, requests from these prefixes keep the client address
headers they carry (X-Forwarded-For, CF-Connecting-IP, and the like). Every
other request loses them, so a client cannot claim another address.

Certificates, the DNS provider and its token, the metrics port, and the
node-lost timeout apply within seconds: the leader restarts its control plane
with them while apps keep serving; the command waits until it answers again.
The token is read from a file or stdin (--dns-token -), stored encrypted, and
never shown.

--log-retention and --log-max-disk bound the log history every node keeps for
`armada app logs --since` (ADR 0043); 0 restores the default (7 days; 10% of
the disk, at most 5Gi). They apply without a restart.

--log-export loki|otlp with --log-endpoint sends every app's output from every
node to that push URL as well (ADR 0044), from now on; none stops it.
--log-token - reads a token from stdin, stored encrypted: a bearer token, or
the password of --log-export-user. --log-export-tenant sets Loki's tenant.

```
armada cluster set [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--acme-ca string` | ACME directory: letsencrypt, letsencrypt-staging, or an https:// URL |
| `--acme-email string` | contact email for the ACME account |
| `--dns-provider string` | DNS provider for the root domain and the names under it, including a wildcard: cloudflare, or none |
| `--dns-token string` | file holding the DNS provider's API token, or - for stdin; an empty file removes it |
| `--log-endpoint string` | push URL of the log store, e.g. https://logs.example.com/loki/api/v1/push or https://otlp.example.com/v1/logs |
| `--log-export string` | send every app's output to a log store as well: loki, otlp, or none |
| `--log-export-tenant string` | Loki tenant (X-Scope-OrgID), for a multi-tenant Loki |
| `--log-export-user string` | user for basic authentication at the log store, with --log-token as the password (empty for a bearer token) |
| `--log-max-disk string` | log history each node keeps at most, e.g. 5Gi (0 for the default: 10% of the disk, at most 5Gi) |
| `--log-retention duration` | how long each node keeps log history, e.g. 168h (0 for the default, 7 days) |
| `--log-token string` | file holding the log store's token, or - for stdin; an empty file removes it |
| `--metrics-port int` | port of the Prometheus metrics endpoint on each server's private address; 0 turns it off |
| `--node-lost-timeout duration` | how long a node may be unreachable before its replicas move to other nodes |
| `--root-domain string` | root domain for app URLs (empty to clear) |
| `--tls` | obtain and renew certificates with ACME (default `true`) |
| `--trusted-proxies strings` | address prefixes of proxies in front of the nodes, comma separated (empty to clear) |

## `armada cluster show`

Show cluster settings.

```
armada cluster show [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

## `armada cluster status`

Summarize the cluster in one line, then list the apps that are not ready
(at most 20) and the nodes that are not ready, if any.

```
armada cluster status [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |
